pictures.name: MR1-Muddy-Road
pictures.prompt: Japan in the 1800s, a narrow country road turned to deep mud by heavy rain, rice fields and dark pines on either side, grey mountains in mist. Two Zen monks walk toward us: Tanzan, a broad-shouldered Zen monk in his forties with a shaved head, a wide straw hat and a dark indigo robe, and beside him Ekido, a thin younger monk in his twenties with a shaved head, a straw hat and a grey robe, carrying a small cloth bundle. Rain streaks, puddles shining, soft grey light with a warm glow on their faces. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: MR2-The-Crossing
pictures.prompt: Japan in the 1800s, a bend in a muddy country road in the rain. At the edge of a wide stretch of mud and puddles stands a young woman in her twenties in a fine silk kimono patterned with pale blossoms and a gold obi sash, holding a paper umbrella, unable to cross without ruining her kimono. Approaching her are Tanzan, a broad-shouldered Zen monk in his forties with a shaved head, a wide straw hat and a dark indigo robe, and Ekido, a thin younger monk in his twenties with a shaved head, a straw hat and a grey robe, carrying a small cloth bundle. Wooden fence, wet pines, grey light, a warm glow on her face. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood.
